fixScope.finding: M1 profile deletion and interrupted multi-role cleanup
fixScope.profileLifecycle: Explicit mkdtemp; no auto-deleting context manager
fixScope.roleShutdown: Every own Popen PGID receives an independent best-effort stop; every stop/log-close exception is retained and remaining roles still attempted
fixScope.postKillEvidence: Actual final OS PID and PGID inventory; a signal, wait return or missing inventory is not empty-process proof
fixScope.profileRemoval: Only after the actual owned PID and PGID snapshot is empty; otherwise retain profile path/logs/remaining and fail
fixScope.cleanupReceipt: Independent attempts to retain handles and process-exit, plus stdout closure; late diagnostic errors fail the supervisor
fixScope.killBoundary: Only new start_new_session PGIDs created by this supervisor; no foreign/escaped-group signals
fixScope.escapedProcesses: Root independent final OS/port/profile review still required

limitations: This is static review and syntax only, not an executed cleanup control or browser run.
Physical diagnostic-write failure cannot guarantee a file; every write is attempted independently and closure/errors also go to stdout.
Root must add the exact new v2 binding to a separately reviewed release; old run.py remains blocked by M1.
No source program, route, clock, media, input or screenshot logic was changed.
